name: Letter bar floods the ground
look: A statement of 2-4 words stands on one line at display size with one straight-stemmed letter (l or I) on the centre of the screen. The camera zooms on that letter until only its stem is left, a flat column of ink that widens to full bleed and becomes the next section's ground; the next statement arrives inside the column while the outgoing words' edges are still in frame. The stem is a solid column rasterised once at full size, never the glyph scaled up; the ground is one layer clipped by clip-path. The section after sits on the same ground, so there is no seam.
reduced: The statement on the page ground, then the next statement on the inverse ground under it.

needs.words: a statement of 2-4 words with an l or an I near its middle, the next section's opening statement of 4-8 words with one line, and a following section on the inverse ground; no pictures

never: an accent on the column; a statement whose stem letter has a curl, a bar or a serif; a light section after it
